faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in the United States?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also known as the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses in the United States communicate with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports automated notifications, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Businesses across New York, California, Texas, and the US can use it for order confirmations, shipping updates, authentication messages, appointment reminders, and customer enquiries.
  • And you don't need to be a developer to get started. With MSG91, businesses can connect WhatsApp, configure supported chatbots, automate eligible messages, and manage customer conversations through a simple, no-code dashboard.

faqs.question: Why should US businesses choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp service provider?
faqs.answer:
• Managing customer communication shouldn't require technical expertise or multiple disconnected tools. MSG91 brings WhatsApp automation, AI chatbots, business notifications, and customer support together in one easy-to-use platform.
  • US businesses can automate repetitive conversations, manage customer enquiries, and create communication workflows without building everything from scratch.
  • And MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With MSG91 One API, businesses can connect SMS, RCS, email, WhatsApp, and voice through unified communication workflows, including fallback when messages fail.
  • You also get MSG91 Hello, an AI-powered customer support platform with a shared inbox where teams can manage conversations together.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in the United States?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in the United States includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers utility, authentication, and service messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard USD pricing, helping businesses reduce communication costs.
  • MSG91's rates for US numbers (+1), in USD, are:
    • Marketing: $0.02256 per message*
    • Utility: $0.00307 per message
    • Authentication: $0.00307 per message
    • Service: $0.00307 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs $7/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable utility messages costs $30.70 with MSG91 compared with $34 at Meta's standard rate, saving $3.30 before subscription fees and taxes.
